## Section 1: Annual Financial Metrics — FY2021 through FY2025

Source: [Stockanalysis.com income statement](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/pep/financials/) (derived from SEC 10-K filings); core EPS and organic growth from earnings press releases cited above.

**Note on fiscal year convention**: PepsiCo's fiscal year ends on the last Saturday of December (e.g., FY2025 ended December 27, 2025; FY2024 ended December 28, 2024).

**Note on segment realignment**: Effective Q1 2025, PepsiCo consolidated 7 reportable segments into 6 — combining Frito-Lay North America (FLNA) and Quaker Foods North America (QFNA) into PepsiCo Foods North America (PFNA), and reshaping international into PBNA, IB Franchise, EMEA, LatAm Foods, and Asia Pacific Foods.

**FY2026 Current-Year Estimates** *[Analyst consensus / Management guidance]*:
- Organic revenue growth: +2% to +4% (guidance affirmed Q1 2026 PR)
- Core EPS growth: +5% to +7% (~$8.55–$8.71 implied, vs. $8.14 base) *[Estimate]*
- Core constant currency EPS growth: +4% to +6%
- Capex: <5% of net revenues (~<$4.7B implied) *[Management guidance]*
- FCF conversion: ≥80% targeting ≥90% by 2027

### Most Recent Quarter: Q1 FY2026 (12 weeks ended March 21, 2026; reported April 16, 2026)

- **Net revenue**: $19,443M (+8.5% reported; +2.6% organic)
- **GAAP diluted EPS**: $1.70 (+27% YoY)
- **Core EPS**: $1.61 (+9% YoY)
- **Operating income**: $3,213M (+24% YoY); operating margin 16.5% (vs. 15.8% prior year)
- **vs. Consensus**: Core EPS $1.61 beat $1.55 estimate (beat by $0.06 / +3.9%); revenue $19.44B beat $18.94B estimate (beat by $500M / +2.6%)
- **Revenue drivers**: +3.4pp FX translation tailwind, +2.6% organic, +2.5pp net M&A/acquisitions
- **Organic volume**: slight positive contribution; North America Foods volume +2%
- **FY2026 guidance**: Affirmed — organic revenue +2% to +4%, core EPS growth +5% to +7%

## Section 4: Segment Data

### Segment Structure Note (Critical)

PepsiCo realigned its reportable segments **effective Q1 FY2025**:
- **Old structure (through FY2024 as reported)**: FLNA, QFNA, PBNA, LatAm, Europe, AMESA, APAC (7 segments)
- **New structure (FY2025 onward, with FY2024 restated)**: PFNA (=FLNA+QFNA), PBNA, IB Franchise, EMEA, LatAm Foods, Asia Pacific Foods (6 segments)

All FY2024 and FY2025 figures below use the **new 6-segment structure** (restated comparables).

### FY2025 and FY2024 Segment Net Revenue and Operating Profit

Source: [stock-analysis-on.net segment analysis](https://www.stock-analysis-on.net/NASDAQ/Company/PepsiCo-Inc/Ratios/Reportable-Segments) (derived from 10-K filings)

| Segment | FY2025 Rev ($M) | % Total | FY2024 Rev ($M) | YoY Chg | FY2025 Op. Profit ($M) | FY2025 Op. Margin | FY2024 Op. Profit ($M) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PFNA (PepsiCo Foods NA) | 27,528 | 29.3% | 27,431 | +0.4% | 6,173 | 22.4% | 6,619 |
| PBNA (PepsiCo Beverages NA) | 28,197 | 30.0% | 27,769 | +1.5% | 1,089 | 3.9% | 2,302 |
| IB Franchise (Intl Bev.) | 4,997 | 5.3% | 4,879 | +2.4% | 1,769 | 35.4% | 1,462 |
| EMEA | 18,025 | 19.2% | 16,658 | +8.2% | 2,106 | 11.7% | 1,971 |
| LatAm Foods | 10,549 | 11.2% | 10,568 | -0.2% | 2,010 | 19.1% | 2,052 |
| Asia Pacific Foods | 4,629 | 4.9% | 4,549 | +1.8% | 369 | 8.0% | 377 |
| **Total** | **93,925** | **100%** | **91,854** | **+2.3%** | **13,516** | **14.4%** | **14,783** |

Key takeaway: PBNA operating margin collapsed to 3.9% in FY2025 (vs. 8.3% in FY2024), dragging total segment operating profit down 8.6% despite revenue growth. IB Franchise op. margin expanded dramatically (35.4% vs. 30.0%).

## Section 5: Geographic Split

Source: Derived from segment mix in FY2025 10-K; geographic disclosure from search summaries citing the 10-K.

| Geography | FY2025 Rev Approx. | % of Total |
|---|---|---|
| United States | ~$52,600M | ~56% |
| International | ~$41,300M | ~44% |

- PFNA ($27.5B) + PBNA domestic portion + IB Franchise domestic = bulk of US revenue
- International segments: EMEA ($18.0B), LatAm Foods ($10.5B), Asia Pacific Foods ($4.6B)
- IB Franchise ($5.0B) includes international beverage bottler relationships

**FX Exposure Notes**:
- FY2025: Foreign currency translation was a ~1pp headwind on reported revenue and ~5pp headwind on core EPS
- FY2026 guidance: ~+1pp FX tailwind on revenue and EPS (per Q4 2025 press release)
- Significant exposure to: EUR, BRL, MXN, GBP, RUB, and LATAM/APAC currencies
- Russia/Ukraine exposure reduced in prior years; geopolitical tensions cited as headwind in FY2024

Source: [Yahoo Finance Q4 2025 summary](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/pepsico-q4-earnings-revenues-beat-154900695.html); [stock-analysis-on.net segment](https://www.stock-analysis-on.net/NASDAQ/Company/PepsiCo-Inc/Ratios/Reportable-Segments)
